name: feature-dev
description: Guided feature development with codebase exploration, approved requirements and architecture, optional feature specs, and quality review.

interface.shortDescription: Guide features through discovery, approved specs, implementation, and review.
interface.longDescription: The Feature Development Plugin provides a systematic 8-phase approach to building new features. It explores the codebase, resolves and approves requirements, optionally writes requirements.md and design.md under docs/specs, compares architecture approaches, implements with test-driven development, and reviews the result against the approved feature specification.
interface.defaultPrompt: Implement this feature from discovery through implementation and review.
